author_receipt.capture_epoch_semantics: Synthetic RNG key only, not an author training/best epoch
author_receipt.configuration_adaptation: CPU device and GCN-only loader declaration; author seed3 and all MonTi architecture/default flags retained.
author_receipt.RNG_scope: Native eval keeps torch.randn latent noise when node_budget>1. Repetition0/1/2 keys are explicit per-case fork_rng, shared across arms; not historical CLI bitwise replay.
author_receipt.scheduler_scope: Official run.py inference constructs initial scheduler objects; eval randomness=False ignores temperature/epsilon. No historical epoch is fabricated.
author_receipt.replication_scope: One fixed author state, three downstream/capture-noise repetitions; not three independently trained author models or a paper-table equivalence claim.
